definition_quote.value: Certified professional midwifery services means the provision of care to a person during a low-risk pregnancy, childbirth, and the postpartum period, and the care of a normal newborn immediately following birth; includes collaboration with other appropriate licensed health care providers as specified by the board by administrative regulation or when otherwise indicated; and does not have the same meaning as the practice of an APRN-designated certified nurse-midwife, or the practice of medicine or osteopathy as defined in KRS 311.550
definition_quote.quote: "Certified professional midwifery services": (a) Means the provision of care to a person during a low-risk pregnancy, childbirth, and the postpartum period, and the care of a normal newborn immediately following birth

advisory_council_composition.value: One (1) nonvoting ex officio board member as liaison; three (3) certified professional midwives (licensed CPMs within 6 months of license availability); two (2) APRN-designated certified nurse-midwives licensed in Kentucky; two (2) obstetricians licensed in Kentucky; one (1) practicing neonatal health care provider licensed in Kentucky; one (1) member of the general public
advisory_council_composition.quote: The council shall be appointed by the board and shall consist of: (a) One (1) member of the board, who shall be a nonvoting, ex officio member and serve as the liaison between the chair of the council and the board; (b) Three (3) certified professional midwives who shall be licensed certified professional midwives within six (6) months of the license availability; (c) Two (2) APRN-designated certified nurse-midwives licensed in Kentucky; (d) Two (2) obstetricians licensed in Kentucky; (e) One (1) practicing neonatal health care provider licensed in Kentucky; and (f) One (1) member of the general public.
